ns2:course.label: Seminar in Musicology
ns2:course.description: Problems in historical and systematic musicology or ethnomusicology; discussions of special problems and reports on individual research. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in Musicology; Music and Sound Studies graduate minor; or consent of instructor. Graduate students in music will be considered if they passed MUS 528 A (consult Class Schedule for specific section information).
